a multicriteria decision approach can be used to support decision making in IT organizations in order to prioritize the acquisition of IT tools.

the use of a combination of the problem structuring method, Strategic Options Development and Analysis (SODA), and a noncompensive multicriteria decision method, Elimination and Choice Expressing Reality (ELECTRE TRI), is an efficient approach to support decision making in the innovation management of IT organizations.
the proposed methodology can be successfully applied to support the decision making process for innovation management in an organization.

the development and use of a decision support model for supporting the innovation management process.
the application of a combination of a decision making approach based upon the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and the Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM).
the development of a decision model for the prioritization of innovation actions, and the use of this model to support decision-making in a real case of an IT organization.

the use of the proposed approach allows the organization to prioritize the actions that are more important to improve its innovation process.
the proposed approach is a useful and efficient tool for decision making in innovation management.
the proposed model is a useful tool for decision making, and it can be successfully implemented in order to improve an IT organization's innovation management.

we have proposed a methodology for prioritization of actions in an IT organization.
we propose an approach to support decision makers in the process of selecting the most important innovation projects for the organization.

the proposed approach allows the decision making process to be structured in a way that it is possible to consider different perspectives of the problem.

the use of a multicriteria decision approach allows to aggregate different points of view and to consider the organizations' priorities and restrictions, thus, providing a more robust decision support system.
